milestones.claim: the stall detector blocks minting another ordinary review round when stalled without a current-round resolution
milestones.doneMeans: transition-effects/machine refuse the REVIEW re-entry mint on a stall (>=STALL_MIN_ROUNDS non-improving) with a structured prompt; a converging trend is not blocked

milestones.claim: structured resolution actions (incl. declare-unreachable) clear the block; an empty/stale one does not
milestones.doneMeans: stall_resolution_set records one of five signed current-round actions that clears the block; declare_unreachable marks the item withdrawn (B-1909) and closes the loop; a previous-round/empty/unsigned resolution is refused

milestones.claim: a hard ceiling/override caps rounds and the adjudication does not double-count with the convergence-breaker
milestones.doneMeans: beyond the ceiling ordinary rounds are refused unless a privileged override is recorded; stall adjudication (review-round) and breaker (advances) each fire only on their own trigger; story_resume --ack clears the breaker not the stall block

milestones.claim: a RED-first mutation-killing smoke reproduces the stall refusal + F-058 unreachable scenario + breaker non-interference, registered in validate
milestones.doneMeans: the registered smoke prints PASS, drives real gate/handler entry points, mutation-kills, and is wired in lattice.config.json + package.json
